title: West African Epidemiology Network on Drug Use (WENDU) Report 2023
collector: Gambia national focal point and contributing agencies; exact product-level responsibility UNKNOWN
funder: European Union / ENACT support to WENDU-related work; product-level allocation UNKNOWN
substance: Drug-related offences; no age × substance table
denominator: All reported drug-related arrestees (650 in 2022; 633 in 2023)
operational_box_definition: box=B52_WENDU_UNDER18_SHARE_OF_RECORDED_ARRESTEES_2022_2023: WENDU share of recorded drug-related arrestees aged 17 years and below among all recorded drug-related arrestees; population=All drug-related arrestees recorded by the WENDU 2022/2023 reporting system, not the general population; substance=Drug-related offences as aggregated in WENDU; no age-by-substance cross-tab; observation_period=Calendar/reporting years 2022 and 2023 as labelled in WENDU table; outcome=Source-reported percentage of all recorded drug-related arrestees who were aged 17 years and below; unit=Percent of recorded arrestees; denominator=All recorded drug-related arrestees in the corresponding year (650 in 2022; 633 in 2023); geography=The Gambia national aggregate; method=Administrative age-distribution table; source-reported percentages retained without recalculation; can_support=Describe the age composition of recorded drug-related arrestees under WENDU definitions; cannot_support=Population prevalence, incidence, individual risk, under-18 substance-specific arrests, route/flow volume, prevention reach or causal effect
box_title: WENDU share of recorded drug-related arrestees aged 17 and below
population: All drug-related arrestees recorded by WENDU in the relevant report year; not the general population
outcome: Source-reported percentage of total recorded drug-related arrestees who were aged 17 years and below
method: Administrative age-distribution table; retain source-published percentages and annual totals.
can_support: Describe composition of recorded drug-related arrestees under WENDU definitions; compare reported annual shares if methodology stable.
cannot_support: Population prevalence; incidence; individual risk; under-18 arrests by substance; youth drug-use trend; prevention reach/effect.
inclusion_rule: Only if numerator age group, all-arrestee denominator, year and Gambia national scope are explicit in the WENDU table.
decision_reason: Distinct estimand and denominator from the existing B06 region-count box. Proposed as new box; source reports values 1.54% (2022) and 4% (2023).
